announcements.headline: MAP Test
summary: Headline 'MAP Test' filed as a Market Update with no market-sensitive flag is almost certainly a system or platform test filing from ZOR — it carries zero informational content regarding operations, financials, or corporate activity.

No actionable insight can be derived: the filing does not reference a project milestone, capital event, or operational update; treating it as a genuine market communication would be a material misreading of the document type.

Investors should disregard this filing entirely for price-signal purposes; any price movement in ZOR proximate to this filing should be attributed to other concurrent news or normal tape noise, not to this announcement.
